title: Flashback
tagline: This is an unusual frame that allow users to request for answers to stuffs that happened far back. Friends are expected to crack their memory by selecting the right answer to the question.
description: This is an unusual frame that allow users to request for answers to stuffs that happened far back. Friends are expected to crack their memory by selecting the right answer to the question. A user creates a questions from an old events and friends try to answer such questions by selecting the correct answer from a list of options
how_its_made: The entire dApp of frame was bootstrapped with the Next js, @farcaster/hub-nodejs, was the tool used to crate frames for question and answer. buttons and actions was tied to buttons to make the frame a multi page frame.  vercel was used to host the dApp. the KV database from vercel was used to store records of questions and answers
